verificationMode: Direct actual HTTP negative/boundary checks using isolated scenario identities; browser fixture untouched

checks.name: Duplicate signup cannot create another identity
Signup without required agreement creates no user
Wrong password rejected without revealing account hash
Protected profile rejects anonymous and invalid-token requests
Buyer cannot call seller reservation list or admin dashboard lists
Anonymous public fabric list returns published entries only with explicit sale type
Anonymous inquiries expose public answer but mask answered private content
Private content accessible to its author, owner seller and admin only
Profile rejects changing email, password or account role
Foreign seller cannot modify or delete another seller fabric
Invalid page ranges rejected on reservations and inquiries
Reservation rejects past pickup instant without changing inventory
Confirmed AI session belongs to original seller and cannot be reused for second fabric
Raw profile DTO excludes password hash and bearer token
